description: This Java class 'ProjectResourceMapper' provides static mapping methods to convert between 'Project' domain model objects and 'ProjectResource' REST resource objects. It includes methods for mapping individual objects as well as collections of these objects.

classes.name: ProjectResourceMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to map between ProjectResource and Project objects, including collections.

methods.name: mapToProject
methods.description: Converts a ProjectResource object to a Project domain model object.

methods.name: mapToProjectResource
methods.description: Converts a Project domain model object to a ProjectResource object.

methods.name: mapToProjects
methods.description: Converts a list of ProjectResource objects to a set of Project objects.

methods.name: mapToProjectResources
methods.description: Converts a set of Project objects to a list of ProjectResource objects.
